args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: After deploying v2.3.1 to production, checkout-api failed health checks in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of 18%. The v2.3.1-rc build had also been unhealthy in staging. We rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. After the rollback, the service reports healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions and the error rate is 0.2%. Follow-up: find the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure before deploying it again.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened a SEV2 incident (INC-0001), which paged the on-call engineer.

- **What was wrong:** v2.3.1 was running in us-east, us-west and eu-west, failing health checks with an 18% error rate. Its release candidate, v2.3.1-rc, had also been unhealthy in staging.
- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production. A status check after the rollback shows all three regions on v2.3.0, healthy, with the error rate down to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 describes the failure, the rollback and the recovery. It also says someone needs to find out why v2.3.1 failed before it's deployed again.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
